name: Cell Subdivision Isosurface Extraction
definition: A method that retains the identity of cells (vertex/node centered data) and eliminates non-linear hanging nodes by subdividing boundary cells into pyramids, allowing standard isosurface techniques to be applied.
summary: Cell Subdivision Isosurface Extraction extracts isosurfaces from AMR data by subdividing boundary cells into pyramids to eliminate hanging nodes, preserving cell identity for debugging at the cost of increased geometric complexity.
